title: Rivergate and Compass
premise: Coral Voss, a salvage diver drowning in debt, takes a contract to recover equipment from a wreck the navy officially denies exists. When a government survey team vanishes near the same stretch of river, Coral and her ragtag crew are conscripted to find them — and discover the wreck, the missing team, and a decades-old cover-up all point upstream to the river's forbidden source. Guided by a compass that belonged to her lost father and bound to a crew she never meant to love, Coral must choose between delivering the truth to those who paid for it or destroying it to protect the people who live along the water. In the end, she floods the evidence into the open, exposing the source's secret at the cost of the salvage that would have cleared her debts — and finds that what she salvaged instead was worth more.
about_author: Lior Villalobos is a former river guide who spent six seasons running cargo boats through contested waterways before turning to fiction. They write adventure stories about people whose loyalties run deeper than their maps.

chapters.title: The Wreck Nobody Names
chapters.summary: Coral dives a sunken navy transport off-limits by unspoken rule, recovering a sealed case she was paid to ignore. POV: Coral. Beat: restless competence masking desperation; the hook of something deliberately buried.

chapters.title: Debt and Salt Water
chapters.summary: Back at the Rivergate docks, Coral faces her creditors and her found-family crew: engineer Tam, deckhand Junie, and old boat pilot Mercer. POV: Coral. Beat: warmth and precarity; the crew is broke but loyal.

chapters.title: A Compass That Points Wrong
chapters.summary: Coral examines her father's compass, which drifts toward the river's upper reaches no matter how she holds it. POV: Coral. Beat: grief surfacing; a mystery inherited, not chosen.

chapters.title: The Survey Team
chapters.summary: A government survey team hires Coral's boat for a routine mapping run upriver, paying triple rate with paperwork too clean. POV: Tam. Beat: unease beneath opportunity; money this easy is never clean.

chapters.title: Gear on the Bank, No Tracks
chapters.summary: Three days in, the survey team vanishes overnight — tents intact, instruments running, no footprints in the mud. POV: Junie. Beat: dread; the wilderness turns from workplace to question mark.

chapters.title: The Navy Arrives
chapters.summary: A naval officer, Commander Ashe, conscripts the crew to search, revealing the vanished team was hunting the same wreck Coral dove. POV: Coral. Beat: coercion; duty arrives wearing a uniform and holding leverage over Coral's debts.

chapters.title: What the Case Contained
chapters.summary: Coral secretly opens the sealed case: hydrographic charts of an unmapped tributary and a photograph of her father's old dive crew. POV: Coral. Beat: betrayal and vertigo; her past is stitched into the cover-up.

chapters.title: Mercer Knows the River
chapters.summary: Mercer admits he ran supply boats to the forbidden source thirty years ago and swore silence after two divers drowned. POV: Mercer. Beat: guilt confessed; the older generation's complicity exposed.

chapters.title: First Blood in the Current
chapters.summary: A patrol skiff rams them at night; the crew survives by running rapids they've never charted. POV: Tam. Beat: fear forged into trust; there's no turning back now.

chapters.title: The Village at the Bend
chapters.summary: They shelter with a river community that treats the source as sacred ground and the surveyors as thieves. POV: Junie. Beat: hospitality and suspicion; the crew sees who pays the cost of secrets.

chapters.title: Sela
chapters.summary: Sela, the village's hydrologist-in-exile, recognizes the compass and tells Coral it belonged to a diver who tried to expose the source years ago. POV: Coral. Beat: connection kindling; Sela becomes ally, guide, and complication.

chapters.title: Ashe's Bargain
chapters.summary: Ashe offers to erase Coral's debts if she delivers the survey team's recovered data and says nothing else. POV: Coral. Beat: temptation; duty versus truth made literal in a signed offer.

chapters.title: Upstream Against the Season
chapters.summary: The dry season is dropping the river fast; every day stranded makes the return journey impossible. POV: Tam. Beat: ticking clock established; the river itself becomes antagonist.

chapters.title: The Drowned Camp
chapters.summary: They find the survey team's forward camp flooded by a deliberate release from upstream — someone controls the water. POV: Junie. Beat: horror; the river is being weaponized.

chapters.title: One Survivor
chapters.summary: Pulled from a strainer, half-drowned surveyor Dr. Imani Reyes whispers that her team found bodies in the source caverns — old ones, in navy gear. POV: Imani (guest POV). Beat: revelation; the cover-up has a body count.

chapters.title: Loyalty Fractures
chapters.summary: Mercer wants to turn back and hand Reyes to Ashe; Coral refuses; Tam is caught between them. POV: Tam. Beat: conflict within the found family; loyalty tested against self-preservation.

chapters.title: The Compass True North
chapters.summary: In a canyon slot, the compass steadies for the first time — pointing not north but home, to a dive site her father marked. POV: Coral. Beat: wonder; inheritance reframed as invitation.

chapters.title: Sela's Confession
chapters.summary: Sela reveals she was exiled for publishing source contamination data, and that Coral's father died trying to finish her work. POV: Sela. Beat: intimacy deepens; love begins to complicate Coral's mission.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Narrows
chapters.summary: Ashe's men ambush the boat; Mercer takes a bullet buying the crew time to escape into side channels. POV: Mercer. Beat: sacrifice; the cost of old sins paid in blood.

chapters.title: Mercer's Last Crossing
chapters.summary: Dying, Mercer gives Coral his logbook from the original dives and asks her to make the river tell the truth. POV: Coral. Beat: grief; the mentor's death converts guilt into obligation.

chapters.title: Portage Through Bone Country
chapters.summary: The crew hauls the boat overland through canyons littered with abandoned mining equipment from the secret operation. POV: Junie. Beat: grim discovery; the scale of the hidden industry revealed.

chapters.title: The Dry Season Bites
chapters.summary: Water runs critically low; they cache the boat and proceed on foot, racing the calendar. POV: Tam. Beat: attrition; hope measured in liters and hours.

chapters.title: Reyes's Data
chapters.summary: Imani recovers enough strength to decode her team's findings: the source feeds a aquifer poisoned by decades of concealed runoff. POV: Imani. Beat: stakes clarified; this is not one crime but a region-wide one.

chapters.title: Ashe Closes the Net
chapters.summary: Helicopters sweep the canyon; the crew hides in a mine adit where Coral finds her father's final dive tags. POV: Coral. Beat: claustrophobia and communion with the dead; resolve hardening.

chapters.title: The Choice Offered Again
chapters.summary: Captured briefly by Ashe's advance team, Coral is offered the same deal — and watches Sela nearly take the fall for her. POV: Coral. Beat: crisis of conscience; love against duty at knife-point.

chapters.title: Escape Down the Adit
chapters.summary: Tam's engineering collapses the mine entrance behind them, sealing their escape and cutting any retreat. POV: Tam. Beat: commitment; the door home closes by their own hands.

chapters.title: The Forbidden Source
chapters.summary: They reach the source: a cathedral cavern where the river rises, ringed with rusted containment structures and the graves of divers sent to keep it quiet. POV: Coral. Beat: awe and horror fused; the heart of the mystery laid bare.

chapters.title: Her Father's Final Dive
chapters.summary: Using the logbook and compass, Coral reconstructs her father's last dive and finds his waterproof testimony sealed in the containment grid. POV: Coral. Beat: catharsis; the ghost answered, the inheritance completed.

chapters.title: Truth as Cargo
chapters.summary: The crew debates: sell the evidence to Ashe, leak it, or give it to the river villages. Every option costs someone. POV: Junie. Beat: moral crucible; loyalty versus truth fully weaponized.

chapters.title: Ashe's Last Patrol
chapters.summary: Ashe corners them at the cavern mouth, offering once more to bury everything — including the deaths — for their silence. POV: Coral. Beat: confrontation; the antagonist reveals he is also trapped by the institution.

chapters.title: The Flood Decision
chapters.summary: Sela's plan: breach the failing containment so the contamination becomes visible, undeniable, impossible to hide — but it will destroy the evidence chain and the valley below must be warned first. POV: Sela. Beat: terrible arithmetic; saving many means damning the proof.

chapters.title: Warning the Bend
chapters.summary: Junie runs the dying river downstream alone to evacuate the village while the others hold the cavern. POV: Junie. Beat: heroism; the smallest crew member carries the heaviest weight.

chapters.title: Standoff in the Cathedral
chapters.summary: As Ashe's men move to seize the testimony, Coral chooses: she reads her father's words aloud over the radio, broadcasting them to every channel before the transmission dies. POV: Coral. Beat: climax begins; truth released cannot be recalled.

chapters.title: Breaching the Grid
chapters.summary: Tam and Coral blow the containment; black water blooms into the clear source as Ashe, broken by the broadcast, orders his men to stand down rather than fire. POV: Tam. Beat: climax peaks; destruction as revelation.

chapters.title: The River Decides
chapters.summary: Flash flood from the breach forces everyone — crew, soldiers, Ashe — onto the same high ledge, enemies made equal by the water. POV: Coral. Beat: reckoning; nature strips rank and pretense.

chapters.title: Aftermath at the Source
chapters.summary: Downstream, the village survived; journalists and investigators arrive with the floodwaters, and Ashe surrenders his records rather than drown alone in the lie. POV: Imani. Beat: justice, imperfect but real.

chapters.title: Burying Mercer
chapters.summary: The crew buries Mercer at the river bend beside the divers from his old crew, reading his logbook aloud. POV: Coral. Beat: mourning; debts of the heart acknowledged.

chapters.title: What the Salvage Was Worth
chapters.summary: Coral's debts die with the salvage contract; broke again, she finds the crew already refitting the boat for honest work. POV: Tam. Beat: relief and humor; poverty shared is lighter than wealth bought with silence.

chapters.title: Compass Points Home
chapters.summary: Coral and Sela, together now, recalibrate the compass — it points steadily downriver, toward Rivergate, toward the life they're choosing. POV: Coral. Beat: love settled; the instrument of grief becomes an instrument of direction.

chapters.title: Rivergate and Compass
chapters.summary: Seasons later, the source is a protected site and the crew runs survey runs for the villages themselves. Coral dives the old wreck one last time and leaves her father's compass on its rail, facing upstream. POV: Coral. Beat: resolution; the past honored, released, and outswum.
